root_text: @SteB777 Sounds exactly like hMPV. I've had it for 2 weeks. Full recovery can be up to 8 weeks. Awful wheezy cough. Feel okay one day, crippling exhaustion the next. Evil virus. Very contagious. No treatments, unless hospitalised. Take care
